text:
Priya: hey team — unexpected family thing, need to swap primary for the midnight window. I can handoff now but need someone to cover 00:30-04:30 UTC. current secondary Sam, are you reachable?

Sam: I can cover until ~02:00 UTC but I’m flying out and will be on airplane mode after that. not ideal. what’s the incident status right now?

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2026-03-14-1721 — prod-api latency spike — severity: P2 — current state: investigating — impacted: /generate endpoints (~5% error rate) — active pages: 2 — runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/api-latency

Priya: thanks. short handoff notes:
- primary concerns: token queueing on inference gateway, occasional 503s from model pool
- quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods --selector=app=gateway` and `kubectl logs -f deploy/gateway -c gateway`
- mitigation steps already tried: scaled gateway from 3->6, rolled back last config, evicted a bad node from pool
- escalation: pager to SRE leads if error rate >10% or latency >2s p95 for 5m (see runbook)
- canary fallback: route 10% traffic to `model-variant-small` via `routing-set canary-small` (only SREs)

Alex: I can take primary from 01:00-05:00 UTC (can start early if needed). will be available to get full context at 00:45. please paste any open logs or interesting traces here before you go. also can we add a 30m overlap window next time? soft handoffs are nicer.

Olivia: I’m on secondary until 03:00 UTC. If Alex is primary from 01:00, I can stay secondary and handle escalations. Sam — can you confirm you’ll do the partial cover until 02:00?

Sam: confirmed — covering until 02:00 then hands off to Olivia/Alex. I’ll stay reachable for urgent escalations until wheels up.

Priya: dumping the most recent snippets:
```
ERROR 2026-03-14T23:58:12Z gateway 503 "model-pool-unavailable" trace=abcd1234
WARN  2026-03-14T23:58:22Z autoscaler scaling gateway from 3->6
INFO  2026-03-14T23:59:04Z node evict: gpu-node-7
```
links: runbook (https://internal.redwood/runbooks/api-latency), rota page (https://calendar.redwood/rota/night-primaries)

Alex: got it. I’ll update rotation and put a short handoff note in the rota calendar. command I used before: `/rota swap primary Priya Alex 2026-03-15T01:00Z --reason 'emergency swap'` (ops-bot will confirm)

oncall-bot: /rota swap accepted — primary change scheduled: Priya -> Alex @ 2026-03-15T01:00Z — notification will post 15m prior

Alex: confirmed. Olivia please take over secondary until 03:00; Sam will drop after 02:00. I’ll stay on the incident until 04:30 and loop in SRE leads if we hit the escalation thresholds.

Olivia: noted. I’ve opened a short incident checklist in the thread and pinned the runbook.

Priya: thank you all. I’m handing off now — leaving my phone on just in case for 15m. much appreciated. :pray:

Sam: safe travels Priya.

PagerDuty: :bell: PagerDuty note: primary changed to Alex at 2026-03-15T01:00Z. Escalation policy remains: primary -> secondary -> oncall-sre.

Alex: quick follow-ups before Priya signs off — 1) who pushed last gateway config? 2) any throttles on upstream model pool? 3) are customer-facing dashboards updated?

Priya: 1) config push by ops-ci — roll ID `ops-roll-1887` (reverted). 2) model pool had transient throttles, we evicted node-7 which reduced availability temporarily. 3) dashboards are live but I added a note about degraded state.

Alex: perfect. I’ll take it from here. Olivia I’ll DM you if I want to escalate to SRE leads. Sam — thanks for the partial cover.

Olivia: sounds good. glhf.

Priya: logging out now, ty everyone. :wave:
